name: Positive particle diffusivity [m2.s-1]
source: the forest on the invariant field, fitted on the 1652 density-functional barriers of nebDFT2k (plan item BT7), read as the percolation barrier of the hop network of LiNiO2 (mp-2348641) in 2 directions
note: the attempt frequency is 1e+13 per second and the hop length 2.89 angstrom, neither of them predicted; the cathode of the cell is a nickel-manganese-cobalt oxide and the structure used is the ordered layered nickel oxide, which is the closest the public set holds

name: Positive electrode OCP [V]
source: the kernel model on the composition of 303 insertion pairs reconstructed from public formation energies (plan item BT3), with the frameworks held out
note: the shift is the model's own error on the layered nickel oxide, which is the closest material to the cell's cathode that the set holds; the ladder reconstructs 3.47 V and the model on the composition 4.08 V, against 3.80 V published

name: Electrolyte conductivity [S.m-1]
source: the kernel model on the composition of 62 measured conductivities of CALiSol-23 (plan item BT5), with the solvent mixture of this electrolyte held out
note: the cell model holds the conductivity as a function of concentration and temperature, so a prediction of one condition can only be a factor on it; the condition is EC0.30+EMC0.70 at 1.11 mol/kg against the one mole per litre the cell model starts from

name: Positive electrode Bruggeman coefficient (electrolyte)
source: the kernel on the radial autocorrelation of a two-phase field, fitted on 200 generated structures with their effective conductivity solved on the grid (the microstructure pilot)
note: the structures are generated and not measured, so what this channel gives is the deviation such a model has, not the exponent of this cell's electrode; the training structures cover the porosity of the cell, as a model fitted for one cell would, and the structures read off are held out; the solid phase carries 0.001 of the conductivity of the electrolyte in the pores

name: Positive electrode exchange-current density [A.m-2]
source: not predicted by this program: a stated spread
note: a 95 % interval of a factor of 10, which is the order the published values for one electrode material differ by; it is here because the ranking of the parameters needs every parameter in it
